family_summary: AI-built pages typically replaced the original body typefaces and nudged body text to a slightly larger size (16–17px) with a roomier line height (about 1.6–1.65), turned empty or hidden h1s into large visible headings, and simplified section headings and wide-tracked uppercase text into plainer size-, case- or font-based hierarchies, while post-title treatment varied and the single handwritten script eyebrow was kept.
